slope-and-area.alt: Two graphs. Left: distance walked in meters against time in seconds, a straight line through the origin to 20 m at 10 s. A dashed triangle between the points (2 s, 4 m) and (8 s, 16 m) shows a run of 6 s and a rise of 12 m, so the slope is 12 m divided by 6 s = 2 m/s; the units of a slope are the y unit over the x unit. Right: speed in m/s against time, a horizontal line at 3 m/s. The rectangle under it from 2 s to 8 s is shaded: its area is 3 m/s times 6 s = 18 m, the distance covered; the units of an area are the y unit times the x unit.
